description: Different model profiles should preserve Python pytest planning decisions, including parser extension, async service unit coverage, FastAPI route integration coverage, and DTO/app wiring deferral.

lockedFields.reason: Python pytest fixtures must preserve the repo-native verification command.
The async service and FastAPI route should remain add-test items.
The existing parser test should be extended for missing edge cases.
The DTO model and app wiring should stay deferred from direct unit testing.
Covered parser logic should keep a stable extend-test item id.
The adapter must preserve matching pytest evidence.
Parser coverage must retain its direct package-qualified Python import proof.
An exact Python source-module import remains direct evidence.
The imported parser result remains directly asserted.
Untested async service code should stay a direct unit-test candidate.
FastAPI route behavior should be planned as integration coverage.
FastAPI app wiring should stay deferred in favor of route or integration tests.
DTO-only Pydantic models should stay covered through consuming boundary tests.
